'''Sha'rellian toops''' were starfish-like creatures that that are soft and sticky like slugs and squeal like pigs. They are found on the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] and shared a symbiotic relationship with the Hutts.

==History==
Sha'rellian toops or just simply toops were sluglike creatures that would attach themselves to the Hutts for security and companionship.<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Complete Season Three">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Three|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Three]]</ref> When toops would attach themselves to a Hutt's head, this gave the Hutt the appearance of having real hair. These appearance enhancing benefits made Hutts fond of the creatures.<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Complete Season Three" />

[[File:MamatheHutt2-HFZ.png|thumb|left|Mama and her highly stacked number of Sha'rellian toops.]]
[[Marlo/Legends|Marlo]] and [[Mama/Legends|Mama]] were two Hutts that wore toops. While Marlo just wore one, Mama wore many stacked toops which gave her the appearance of having a high topknot. Mamma also kept several of the creatures in her [[Mama the Hutt's house/Legends|home]] on Nal Hutta and allowed the creatures to crawl around on her enormous body, and used them to hurl at [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] when he and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] entered her home.<ref name="HfZ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sha'rellian toops are the equivalent to the real-world [[Wikipedia:Toupée|toupée]].<ref name="HfZ Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode309.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Hunt for Ziro}}</ref>

The toops' skin texture was designed to involk the appearance of slicked hair.<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Complete Season Three" />
